title: Split SQL integration tests by feature area
problem: tests/sql_integration.rs contained 181 tokio tests across DDL, DML, SELECT, aggregation, join, index/cache, set/subquery, expressions, windows, views/constraints, returning/upsert/vector/RBAC, making focused iteration slow and difficult to review.
approach: Extract tests into topic-specific integration test targets under tests/sql_*.rs.
Keep tests/sql/common.rs as the shared setup/query/exec helper module.
Shrink tests/sql_integration.rs to a smoke target so existing cargo test --test sql_integration workflows continue to work.
Verify all original test names are present exactly once across the topic targets.
risk_controls: Do not alter database implementation or dashboard/ui files.
Compare test names from HEAD:tests/sql_integration.rs against new topic targets for missing, extra, or duplicate tests.
Run cargo check --lib and every new SQL integration test target.
